info.name: SS-6390 Atlas DEV six-step cash flow
info.description: AirAPI endpoints from SERVICE APIs TEST ENV only. Creates DEV sandbox booking and requests cash issuance. Configure local api_authorization, atlas_client_id, atlas_client_secret, booking_username and booking_password. No retries or extra endpoints. Baggage schema assertions run even on Retry responses; Cash 408/Retry is an accepted DEV sandbox outcome per user clarification; ticket numbers are not required.

exec: const url=pm.iterationData.get('search_url')||pm.collectionVariables.get('search_url');if(new URL(url).origin!==host){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw new Error('DEV Search only');}pm.variables.set('search_url',url);for(const key of ['selected','booking_body','booking_info','ticket_attempted'])pm.collectionVariables.unset(key);
const key="selected"; const saved=pm.collectionVariables.get(key); if(!saved){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw new Error('Run previous steps first');}
function ensure(ok,message){if(!ok)throw new Error(message||"Missing or unsupported fresh booking input");}
const key="booking_body"; const saved=pm.collectionVariables.get(key); if(!saved){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw new Error('Run previous steps first');}

const cm=pm.iterationData.get('expected_carry_on_length_cm');const inch=pm.iterationData.get('expected_carry_on_length_inch');const path=pm.iterationData.get('segments_path')||pm.collectionVariables.get('segments_path');const segments=path.split('.').reduce((v,k)=>v?.[k],d);if(cm!==undefined && cm!=='')for(const seg of segments||[])pm.test('Source-supplied carry-on dimensions mapped',()=>{pm.expect(seg.carryOn.ADT.lengthCm).to.equal(Number(cm));pm.expect(seg.carryOn.ADT.lengthInch).to.be.oneOf(String(inch).split(';').map(Number));});

const p=pm.iterationData.get('segments_path')||pm.collectionVariables.get('segments_path');const segs=p.split('.').reduce((v,k)=>v?.[k],d);pm.test('SS-6390: segment baggage exists',()=>pm.expect(segs).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty);if(Array.isArray(segs))for(const s of segs){for(const type of ['baggage','carryOn'])for(const [ptc,b] of Object.entries(s[type]||{})){pm.test(type+' full texts are null',()=>{pm.expect(b.baggageFullTextA == null).to.equal(true);pm.expect(b.baggageFullTextD == null).to.equal(true);});pm.test(type+' piece formatting',()=>pm.expect(b.numberOfPcs).to.match(type==='baggage'?/^\d{2}P$/:/^\d+P$/));}}
